entries.name: exists_clearedForm_outerProduct_decomp
entries.note: SOLE residual debt of the now-PROVED 028 bridge (signRank_le_of_computableWithHeadsN) and signRank_le_of_headForm. entries.name: exists_unit_sign_factorization
entries.note: Rank factorization of a rank-(signRank M) sign-matching matrix into r columns (u_x, v_y ∈ ℝ^r with ⟨u_x,v_y⟩ = A_xy ≠ 0); normalize each to a unit vector (positive scaling preserves the strict signs).

entries.name: exists_isotropic_reposition
entries.note: Forster's isotropic-position kernel (deepest analytic leaf): general-position perturbation under the sign margin, then minimize Φ(P)=∑_x log(u_xᵀ P u_x) over {P≻0, det P=1} (coercivity via (★) count + compactness), and read the isotropy ∑_x û_x û_xᵀ = (N/r)I from the first-order/Lagrange condition.

entries.name: forster_main_chain
entries.note: Lower bound: ∑_{x,y} M_xy⟨u_x,v_y⟩ = ∑|⟨u_x,v_y⟩| ≥ ∑⟨u_x,v_y⟩² = N²/r (unit vecs give |t|≥t²; isotropy hiso applied to each v_y with ‖v_y‖=1). Upper bound: same sum = tr(Uᵀ M V) ≤ specNorm·N by column Cauchy–Schwarz. Combine N²/r ≤ specNorm·N.
